name: FacilityTypeMyCore
title: MOH Healthcare Facility Type
publisher: Data Team, Digital Health Division, Ministry of Health Malaysia
description: NATIONAL. MOH-maintained classification of healthcare facility types. No international code system covers the Malaysian facility taxonomy (Klinik Desa, Klinik 1 Malaysia, Klinik Kesihatan Ibu dan Anak and the rest).

concept.definition: MOH hospital providing a broad range of specialist clinical services.
MOH hospital providing a limited range of specialist clinical services.
MOH hospital providing inpatient care without resident specialist services.
Community clinic established under the Klinik 1Malaysia programme, providing basic outpatient care in urban areas.
Rural health clinic staffed by a community nurse, providing maternal, child and basic outpatient care.
Government health clinic providing primary care, public health and maternal and child health services.
Health clinic providing maternal and child health services.
Community clinic providing outpatient primary care services.
MOH institution providing a defined specialist service outside the general hospital network.
MOH hospital designated as the principal referral hospital for a state.
Facility type not recorded in the source register.
